shots.text: The Elder Broodmother fell in the oldest tree in the world. What climbed out of the grey bark was a very old woman, and she was tired.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: The Broodmother collapsing; grey bark peeling away to reveal Elowen, bent, with white-blossom hair.

shots.text: The tree will live. It will not live long. Take its seeds, child. Take them somewhere with light.
shots.speaker: elowen
shots.art_note: Elowen pressing a single glowing seed into Sylvaine's hand.

shots.text: The people of Sylvanmere left by the highest branches. Sylvaine carried the seed to Solenne in her hand the whole way.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Deepwood folk climbing up and away along the crown of the great tree; Sylvaine last, hand closed around a small green light.
